name: Jiriah
title: Descendant of Benjamin
summary: Jiriah is a person mentioned in 1 Chronicles as a descendant of the tribe of Benjamin. He is listed in the genealogies as part of Israel's tribal history. Little else is known about him beyond his place in the family tree.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Benjamin's Genealogy
keyEvents.description: Jiriah is listed among the sons of Elpaal in the genealogy of the tribe of Benjamin, as part of Israel's family history.

keyEvents.title: Elpaal and His Sons in the Tribe of Benjamin
keyEvents.description: Jiriah is mentioned along with his brothers as part of Elpaal's descendants, an important branch of the tribe of Benjamin.

keyEvents.title: The Tribe of Benjamin in Jerusalem
keyEvents.description: The genealogy where Jiria is mentioned is linked to those from the tribe of Benjamin who lived in Jerusalem and surrounding cities.

keyEvents.title: Overview of the Tribe of Benjamin
keyEvents.description: Jiria is part of the broader overview of Benjamin's descendants recorded in the Books of Chronicles to preserve Israel's tribal history.
